model: auto-selected per series by backtest MASE

models.snaive: Seasonal naive — each month repeats the most recent observed value for that calendar month
models.ets: Holt-Winters — damped additive trend + multiplicative monthly seasonality, smoothing grid-searched on one-step error
models.prophet: Meta Prophet — additive trend + multiplicative yearly + country holidays + COVID 2020-21 events + GDP/capita regressor where available

selection: lowest mean MASE over the backtest folds — the best-scoring model wins outright. Candidates are tried simplest-first so an exact tie goes to the simpler model; no other handicap is applied (SELECT_MARGIN=0.0). MASE scales by the in-sample seasonal-naive MAE, so it stays finite on series that approach zero — which MAPE does not, and why MAPE is published but never decides.
backtest: rolling-origin, up to 3 folds x 12mo holdouts. The OLDEST fold is reserved to tune Prophet's hyperparameters and is scored by nobody, so no candidate is compared on a fold that chose its own settings — Prophet gets 4 attempts and the other candidates one, and grading that on the same months would favour it. Every remaining fold scores every candidate identically. No fold whose test window falls in 2020-03..2022-12 is scored at all, and year-over-year steps touching that window are excluded from the MASE denominator: training through a shutdown to predict the rebound is not a test any model can pass, and leaving the collapse in the denominator deflated every MASE (92% of series affected, median 1.45x inflation). 50% interval coverage measured on the same held-out months
tuning: Prophet's changepoint_prior_scale and seasonality_prior_scale are searched per series over 4 configs on the reserved fold; the winner is published as prophet_cfg. Fourier order is fixed at 2 globally (settled on a 164-series head-to-head). Holt-Winters searches level-only / additive / damped-additive trend plus its smoothing constants on in-sample one-step error.
bands: each candidate's raw interval is rescaled by the 50th percentile of its held-out error measured in units of its own band half-width, clamped to [0.25, 4.0]. Raw coverage of a nominal 50% band ran at a median 39% for Prophet and 100% for the seasonal naive, so the label was wrong in both directions. `coverage` stays the raw out-of-sample number; `coverage_cal` is the scaled band on the same months and is therefore in-sample. Applied to the forward forecast only - the shipped backtest rows keep the band the model actually claimed.
note: Short-term forecasts. Fit nightly by .github/workflows/refresh-data.yml on the real observed series. Per-airport output lives in data/forecasts/<IATA>.json, fetched by the browser once that gateway is selected; each metric carries the chosen model at the top level plus every candidate's scores (and the alternatives' forecasts) under `candidates`, which is what the model toggle in the UI switches between. This file only carries the shared model metadata.
